result.title: DEFlow: Deep Equilibrium Flow Maximum-Entropy Reinforcement Learning
result.summary: Expressive flow policies can represent multiple high-value actions, but sampling them with few integration steps while retaining tractable action densities remains challenging. We introduce DEFlow, a deep equilibrium flow policy that replaces explicit Euler sampling with implicit Euler integration and solves all intermediate actions jointly as an equilibrium system. We combine implicit differentiation with a discrete change-of-variables formula for the final-action density, enabling off-policy training within soft actor-critic without backpropagating through solver iterations. DEFlow achieves an average relative improvement of approximately 10% in mean successful coverage over the strongest baseline across four Multi-Goal docking variants. It also achieves the highest mean time-averaged return on four of five manipulation tasks, while remaining broadly competitive across five MuJoCo tasks. These results support implicit flow policies for tasks requiring both diversity and precision, at the cost of additional nonlinear and linear solves. Primary

AI.brief_summary: DEFlow 提出深度平衡流策略，用隐式 Euler 积分替代显式采样，把中间动作联合求解为平衡系统，并以隐式微分配合离散变量替换公式得到最终动作密度，从而在 soft actor-critic 中无需对求解器迭代反传即可离策略训练，在多目标对接等连续控制任务上取得约 10% 的平均相对提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其将迭代中间状态作为平衡系统联合求解、并用隐式微分绕开对求解迭代的反传，可能与 loop／迭代式 latent 推理的状态更新与训练监督（固定点求解、免 BPTT 式梯度）存在方法借鉴关系，但属连续控制领域，迁移可行性需人工核查。
